passes.note: vom english-teacher in der Nachprüfung selbst formuliert

items.ex: It took months of testing, but we [eventually] launched the platform.
items.why: Adverb: schließlich, am Ende. „Eventuell“ heißt possibly oder perhaps.

items.ex: The [actual] costs were 20 percent higher than planned.
items.why: Adjektiv: tatsächlich, wirklich. „Aktuell“ heißt current.

items.ex: Digital archiving has [become] a core requirement for our clients.
items.why: Verb: werden (zu etwas). „Bekommen“ heißt get oder receive.

items.ex: Postponing the launch until the third quarter is a [sensible] decision.
items.why: Adjektiv: vernünftig. „Sensibel“ heißt sensitive.

items.ex: Only administrators can [control] access to the archive.
items.why: Verb: steuern, beherrschen. „Kontrollieren“ im Sinn von prüfen heißt check.

items.ex: The [chef] at the conference dinner prepared a vegetarian menu.
items.why: Nomen: Küchenchef(in). Der „Chef“ im Büro ist the boss oder the manager.

items.ex: The client sent us a small [gift] after the successful go-live.
items.why: Nomen: Geschenk. „Gift“ (Substanz) heißt poison.

items.ex: A short checklist is [handy] when you onboard new users.
items.why: Adjektiv: praktisch, nützlich. Das „Handy“ heißt cell phone (UK: mobile).

items.ex: The global market is worth several [billion] dollars.
items.why: Nomen/Zahl: 1.000.000.000. Die deutsche „Billion“ heißt trillion.

items.ex: The migration was delayed; [consequently], we missed the audit date.
items.why: Adverb: folglich. „Konsequent“ (beharrlich) heißt consistent.

items.ex: I do not understand the [meaning] of this clause.
items.why: Nomen: Bedeutung, Sinn. „Meinung“ heißt opinion.

items.ex: I was [irritated] by the constant delays.
items.why: Adjektiv: genervt. „Irritiert“ (verwirrt) heißt confused.

items.ex: The client was [sympathetic] when we explained the delay.
items.why: Adjektiv: verständnisvoll. „Sympathisch“ heißt nice oder likeable.

items.ex: The contract contains a [provision] on early termination.
items.why: Nomen: Bestimmung, Vorkehrung. Die „Provision“ heißt commission.

items.ex: She [said] that the contract would arrive on Monday.
items.why: say + that-Satz oder say to sb. Mit Person direkt: tell.

items.ex: Please [tell] me when the audit starts.
items.why: tell + Person (+ Info). Ohne Person: say.

items.ex: Can I [borrow] your laptop charger for the meeting?
items.why: borrow = sich leihen (nehmen). Geben heißt lend.

items.ex: Could you [lend] me your laptop charger for the meeting?
items.why: lend = verleihen (geben). Nehmen heißt borrow.

items.ex: Please submit the report [by] Friday.
items.why: by = bis spätestens (Frist, einmalig). Dauer: until.

items.ex: The office will stay closed [until] Monday.
items.why: until = bis (Zustand dauert an). Frist: by.

items.ex: There is a [possibility] that the audit will be postponed.
items.why: possibility = Möglichkeit, Eventualität. Chance: opportunity.

items.ex: This conference is a great [opportunity] to meet new clients.
items.why: opportunity = Chance, Gelegenheit. Eventualität: possibility.

items.ex: The delay will [affect] our rollout plan.
items.why: affect = Verb, beeinflussen. Das Nomen „Auswirkung“: effect.

items.ex: The new policy had a positive [effect] on productivity.
items.why: effect = Nomen (have an effect on). Das Verb: affect.

items.ex: Prices are expected to [rise] next quarter.
items.why: rise, rose, risen: ohne Objekt. Mit Objekt: raise.

items.ex: We plan to [raise] our prices next quarter.
items.why: raise, raised: braucht ein Objekt. Ohne Objekt: rise.

items.ex: Thank you for your [advice] on the migration.
items.why: advice = Nomen, nicht zählbar. Das Verb: advise.

items.ex: I would [advise] you to back up the data first.
items.why: advise = Verb (advise sb to do). Das Nomen: advice.

items.ex: The [economic] outlook for the region remains uncertain.
items.why: economic = die Wirtschaft betreffend. Sparsam: economical.

items.ex: This archive system is more [economical] than the old one.
items.why: economical = sparsam, günstig im Betrieb. Volkswirtschaftlich: economic.

items.ex: We could [lose] the contract if we miss the deadline.
items.why: lose, lost, lost (Verb, ein o). Das Adjektiv „lose“: loose.

items.ex: Please do not leave any [loose] pages in the folder.
items.why: loose = Adjektiv, locker, lose (zwei o). Das Verb: lose.

items.ex: Please [ensure] that all files are archived by Friday.
items.why: ensure = dafür sorgen, dass. Versichern: insure.

items.ex: The company must [insure] the equipment against theft.
items.why: insure = versichern (Versicherung). Sicherstellen: ensure.

items.ex: Please confirm your billing [address] before we ship.
items.why: Nomen/Verb: zwei d, zwei s. Merke: add + ress.

items.ex: Data protection is the [responsibility] of every employee.
items.why: Nomen: endet auf -ibility, nicht -ability.

items.ex: The steering [committee] meets every other Tuesday.
items.why: Nomen: zwei m, zwei t, zwei e.

items.ex: Please let us know when you [receive] the package.
items.why: Verb: „i vor e, außer nach c“ (rec-ei-ve).

items.ex: The new hall can [accommodate] up to 300 guests.
items.why: Verb: zwei c und zwei m.

items.ex: Please keep the invoices in a [separate] folder.
items.why: Adjektiv: sep-a-rate, mit „a“ in der Mitte.

items.ex: We hired an [independent] auditor to review the process.
items.why: Adjektiv: endet auf -ent, nicht -ant.

items.ex: Digital archiving is a growing [business] in Europe.
items.why: Nomen: bus-i-ness, mit „i“ vor „n“.

items.ex: The pilot project was a great [success].
items.why: Nomen: zwei c und zwei s.

items.ex: The error [occurred] after the last update.
items.why: Verb: occur, aber occurred (r wird verdoppelt).

items.ex: I am [referring] to your email from Monday.
items.why: Verb: refer, aber referring (r wird verdoppelt).

items.ex: We will [definitely] meet the deadline.
items.why: Adverb: defin-ite-ly, mit „i“, nicht „a“.

items.ex: Her [argument] for the cloud solution convinced the board.
items.why: Nomen: ohne „e“ vor -ment.

items.ex: The test [environment] is separate from production.
items.why: Nomen: envir-on-ment, mit „n“ vor „m“.

items.ex: Few customers knew about the [existence] of this feature.
items.why: Nomen: endet auf -ence, nicht -ance.

items.ex: Our revenue is [dependent] on a few large customers.
items.why: Adjektiv: -ent. „dependant“ ist nur britisch und nur Nomen (Angehöriger).

items.ex: We need more [information] about the interface.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar: kein -s, kein „an“. Ein Stück: a piece of information.

items.ex: Thank you for your [feedback] on the draft.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar: kein -s. Ein Stück: a piece of feedback.

items.ex: All office [equipment] must be returned on the last day.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar. Ein Stück: a piece of equipment.

items.ex: Our [software] integrates with most ERP systems.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar. Ein Stück: a piece of software.

items.ex: The office [furniture] will be delivered next week.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar (deutsch Plural). Ein Stück: a piece of furniture.

items.ex: Her [knowledge] of records management is impressive.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar: kein Plural. Aber richtig: a good knowledge of sth.

items.ex: We have no [evidence] that the data was lost.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar. Ein Stück: a piece of evidence.

items.ex: The team did some [research] on competitor pricing.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar: kein -s im Alltag und im Business.

items.ex: I have good [news] about the budget.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar, steht mit „is“. Ein Stück: a piece of news.

items.ex: There was little [progress] on the migration this week.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar: kein Plural. Ein Stück: a step forward.

items.ex: Please keep your [luggage] with you at all times.
items.why: Nomen, nicht zählbar. Ein Stück: a piece of luggage.

items.ex: Our schedule will [depend on] the customer's approval.
items.why: depend + on (nicht from/of). Adjektiv: dependent on.

items.ex: The package [consists of] three modules.
items.why: consist of (nicht „out of“), keine Verlaufsform: nie „is consisting of“.

items.ex: She is [responsible for] the archive migration.
items.why: responsible + for (nicht of). Die Person: responsible to sb.

items.ex: I would like to [apply for] the position of sales manager.
items.why: apply for + Stelle, apply to + Firma: apply to Siemens for a job. Nicht: apply on.

items.ex: We need to [discuss] the pricing before Friday.
items.why: discuss + Objekt, ohne Präposition. Aber: a discussion about.

items.ex: All managers must [attend] the meeting.
items.why: attend + Objekt, ohne at/to. Attend to = sich kümmern um.

items.ex: Please [contact] our support team if the error continues.
items.why: contact + Person, ohne with/to.

items.ex: I would like to [emphasize] the importance of data security.
items.why: emphasize + Objekt, ohne on. Nomen: emphasis on.

items.ex: Could you [explain] the process to the new team members?
items.why: explain sth to sb; nicht „explain sb sth“.

items.ex: We plan to [enter] the Asian market next year.
items.why: enter + Objekt, ohne in/into. „enter into“ nur bei Verträgen und Gesprächen.

items.ex: I will [give a presentation] on our new archive at the conference.
items.why: give a presentation; „hold“ ist hier ein Germanismus.

items.ex: The board will [make a decision] by the end of the month.
items.why: make a decision (US). Brit.: take a decision.

items.ex: It is a pleasure to [do business] with Hanse Archiv GmbH.
items.why: do business with sb; make = herstellen, do = tätigen.

items.ex: Everyone can [make a mistake], so please report it early.
items.why: make a mistake (nicht do). Gleich: make an error.

items.ex: We must [take measures] to prevent data loss.
items.why: take measures/steps/action; meist im Plural.

items.ex: We need to [meet the deadline] on Friday.
items.why: meet a deadline; Verwandt: miss a deadline.

items.ex: It is too early to [draw a conclusion] from these figures.
items.why: draw a conclusion (from sth); nicht make/pull.

items.ex: These figures [raise the question] of whether we need more staff.
items.why: raise a question = ansprechen. Einfach fragen: ask a question.

items.ex: Before we [make an offer], we need your final requirements.
items.why: make an offer (nicht do/give). Schriftliches Angebot mit Preisen: quote oder proposal.

items.ex: The archive is fully [compliant] with GoBD.
items.why: compliant = regelkonform (Adjektiv). Beschwerde: complaint.

items.ex: We received a [complaint] about the slow search.
items.why: complaint = Beschwerde (Nomen). Regelkonform: compliant.
